thread:
lena: Heads-up: Finance and Acme both pushed back asking for a small observability product that ties cost -> traces -> routes. They want minimal surface but usable for audits. Can we pick an MVP?

joel: Suggestion: define a "mini-catalogue" of 4 dimensions only: route, model_family, model_variant, and cache_hit. Build 3 tiles: cost/request, p99 latency, error-rate. Keep drill-down to 1 click into traces.

priya: Agree on dimensions. Important: exportable weekly report (CSV) with per-route cost attribution and a simple SHA audit header. Acme wants signed exports.

carlos: Engineering caveat: adding model_variant tag multiplies cardinality for long-tail customers. Propose we canonicalize variants to short names and add a per-customer sampling policy for metrics retention.

infra-bot: Alert: ingestion pipeline currently discards free-form route labels. Need canonicalization step before storage. Also current metric tiering charges per unique cardinality key.

lena: Launch criteria proposal (draft):
- Hosted + Dedicated dashboards with three cards (cost/request, p99, errors) scoped to route + model_family
- Trace spans include route and cache_hit attributes
- One-click drill from cost tile to traces filtered by route/model_variant
- Weekly signed CSV export to customer S3 or secure FTP
- Canary: 5% traffic for 48h, explicit sampling for traces in canary cohort
- Perf gate: tail overhead <= 5% on p99 latency

joel: Implementation notes: runtime flag "observability.minicatalogue=true". Example snippet: 
```
span.set_attribute("route", route_id)
span.set_attribute("cache_hit", cache ? "1" : "0")
```
On ingestion, run canonicalization map for route ids.

priya: UX: keep tiles compact, add tenant dropdown, time presets [1h,6h,24h,7d]. Add a tiny modal for export settings (transport, KMS key). I can mock both compact and stacked card layouts by Tue.

carlos: Backend tasks: ingestion change + cardinality cap + export pipeline (S3 + SFTP + on-prem agent). Export must include audit header (timestamp, exporter id, SHA256 of payload). Acme requires KMS-wrapped uploads.

infra-bot: Note: policy - any new metric tag must be approved in metrics-schema and will be billed to the owning team.

lena: Risks & mitigations:
- Cardinality growth -> canonicalize + cap + document retention tradeoffs
- Runtime perf -> canary + microbench. If overhead >5% rollback flag off-by-default
- Enterprise export complexity -> mark SFTP/on-prem as enterprise-only and queue legal check for signed transfers

joel: Timeline guess: 2 sprints if we parallelize (runtime + ingestion + UI). If we include export options in first 2 sprints, might stretch to 3.

priya: Acceptance checklist to confirm before ship:
- [ ] route + cache span attrs emitted in both hosted and dedicated
- [ ] canonicalization map applied in ingestion
- [ ] dashboard tiles for hosted + dedicated present and filterable by tenant
- [ ] drill -> trace flow works end-to-end
- [ ] weekly signed CSV export implemented and tested to S3 & SFTP
- [ ] canary runbook and rollback criteria documented
- [ ] UX mocks reviewed by CS/Acct teams

carlos: I'll own ingestion changes and export pipeline. Will draft initial PR and a cardinality cap proposal by Fri (1768014000).

joel: I'll own runtime flag & bench. PR by end of sprint 1.

priya: I'll deliver mocks Tue (1768013000) and export modal by Wed.

lena: Let's reconvene Thursday sync to lock scope and create JIRA tickets. If anyone needs to narrow further to hit sprint, propose removing drill-to-traces from MVP and offer it in sprint+1.

infra-bot: Reminder: file a metrics-schema change ticket referencing the canonical route field before enabling the flag.

lena: Thanks all  I'll open the parent ticket and assign sub-tasks after Thu. Closing thread for now.
